name: Flatbed Firewood and Lumber
old_description: Maybe you can’t find an activity all your friends will agree on, or maybe you need a way to pass the time at your next event. No matter why you’re looking for an axe throwing company in Bismarck, ND, Flatbed Firewood has you covered. We make it easy for you to throw a lively party. All you have to do is book our services, and we’ll be at your event’s location with our mobile trailer.
about:
Flatbed Firewood and Lumber operates from Bismarck, North Dakota, where it was founded in 2010. The company began as a firewood supplier and has since expanded into mobile entertainment, lumber processing, and equipment distribution.

The business runs three main lines: a mobile axe-throwing trailer that travels to events across the region; a firewood operation supplying restaurants and residents; and a wood shop producing live-edge slabs and custom stair treads milled from hardwood and softwood trees harvested locally. It also serves as an authorized dealer for Prime Attachments, stocking backhoes, earth augers, pallet forks, and other skid-steer implements.

Customers include event planners seeking on-site entertainment, Bismarck-area restaurants buying cooking wood, custom home builders incorporating one-of-a-kind stair treads and slabs into Parade of Homes projects, and contractors needing skid-steer attachments. The company notes that its stair treads have been featured in multiple Bismarck Parade of Homes showcases.

Flatbed Firewood emphasizes sustainable sourcing, reclaiming urban trees from North Dakota boulevards for its stair treads and slabs. The mobile axe-throwing trailer is promoted as a turnkey party solution, while the Prime Attachments dealership provides immediate access to a full line of skid-steer tools.
